title: Unit-normalized open support comparisons on strict systems
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, Operations o and section/representative-normalized Compositors c of [def-strict-coefficient-system-operation-data]. There is an OpenComparisons for o,c, retaining its invertible open unit, cartesian open base-change isomorphism and inverse transpose, open tensor projection isomorphism and inverse transpose, and clopen direct-image identification with its prescribed transpose. This asserts the open-support comparison part only and supplies no operation or compositor existence.

proof.text: Transport full faithfulness of the existing fixed-coefficient pro-etale open extension through the intrinsic module realization equivalences. Its ordinary unit is invertible. Exact localization of its composite with restriction is isomorphic to the identity; the derived adjunction therefore has invertible unit. Apply the normalized open evaluation mate identity to the system unit. Every evaluation is invertible, so joint conservativity of the fixed evaluation calculus makes the system open unit invertible.

proof.text: For a system N whose every finite evaluation belongs to the essential image of finite open extension, the finite open counit is invertible by full faithfulness. The counit mate identity and the recorded open evaluation normalization show that every evaluation of the system counit is invertible. Joint conservativity makes that counit invertible. This uses evaluation only to detect isomorphisms, not equality of morphisms.

proof.text: Finite cartesian open exchange proEtale_openSquareExchange, together with pullback and open evaluation, places the pullback of an extended system in finite open essential images. Define beta inverse by the required open-adjunction inverse transpose of pullback of the system unit followed by c.square.inv. Naturality follows from unit and square naturality. The inverse transpose is extension of an isomorphism followed by the invertible open counit established above. It is therefore invertible and gives beta with exactly the prescribed transpose; no comparison of c.square with an independently chosen exchange is needed.

proof.text: Take the finite native open tensor models for the fixed derived calculi. Their gamma isomorphisms, transported by compactSupportOpenModel to intrinsic extension, and evaluationTensor put the tensor of an extended system with any system in every finite open essential image. Its system open counit is thus invertible. Define projection inverse by the required inverse transpose of tensor of the unit with identity followed by pullbackTensorSystemComparison.inv. Product naturality and unit naturality give a natural transformation. The inverse transpose is extension of an isomorphism followed by this invertible counit, proving projection and its exact transpose formula.

proof.text: For clopen j, use the proved source-library theorem ProEtale.isIso_openImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar_of_isClosed_range (WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/ProEtale/FiniteCoefficient/LowerShriek/Proper.lean). Whisker its isomorphism by intrinsic module realization equivalences. Direct image is consequently exact. Uniqueness of right adjoints identifies its exact localization with the fixed universal derived direct image. Thus the finite direct-adjunction unit at an extended object is invertible. The recorded direct evaluation unit equation and joint conservativity imply invertibility of the analogous system unit. Compose this unit with direct image of the inverse open unit. Naturality gives the clopen isomorphism and the adjunction unit formula proves its prescribed transpose. Assemble the seven fields of OpenComparisons. All constructions cover empty opens, identities and zero objects.
